description: The shared chapter fingerprint vector, devbook.chapter.fingerprint@1 per resources/chapter-fingerprint.md. Every implementation — devbook's metadata.mjs and chapter-hash.mjs, spec-manager's, Backlog's — reads each block case's markdown as the file at path, takes the block address names, folds in each demo the block belongs to from demos (a path absent from it does not exist), and must produce canonical and fingerprint exactly. Each change case is a change folder: its proposal.md and each delta at its path, and must produce canonical and fingerprint exactly. A case with sameAs fingerprints the same as the case it names; one with differsFrom, differently.
algorithm: sha256: followed by the first 8 lowercase hex of SHA-256 over the canonical text in UTF-8
